evals.prompt: Set up mail.acme.com for sending with LetMeSend.Email.
evals.expected_output: domains-get for exact DNS records, publish SPF/DKIM/DMARC, then domains-verify with retry-on-propagation.
expectations: Gets exact records from domains-get (does not invent values)
Mentions propagation delay / retry rather than instant success

evals.prompt: Our emails started landing in spam. What do I check?
evals.expected_output: Reads domain-health-get/history, checks DNS alignment, bounce/complaint signals, list hygiene.
expectations: Covers both DNS alignment and reputation signals

evals.prompt: Can I send from a domain I haven't verified yet?
evals.expected_output: No - verification is required before any sending.
expectations: States verification is mandatory before sending
